summary.zh: 规划 Google、Meta 等平台的账户结构、出价与预算
summary.en: Plan paid campaigns: account structure, targeting, bids and budget

description.zh: 覆盖 Google、Meta、LinkedIn 和 X 的付费投放策略：账户结构、人群定向、出价、再营销和预算分配，并评估账户健康度与 ROAS。适合开新广告系列，或投放跑不动、成本上涨时用来排查。只涉及投放策略，不写广告文案，评分脚本需要本地 Python 环境。
description.en: Paid strategy on Google, Meta, LinkedIn and X: structure, targeting, bids, retargeting, budget, plus a health score and ROAS model. Use it for a new campaign or when spend stalls and costs climb. No ad copy; scorers need Python.
